in_marathi.name: Vidhur
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Knowledge, wisdom, intellect
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vidhur हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vidhur is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vidh' meaning 'to know'. The name is a tribute to the knowledgeable, wise and intelligent individuals. It is often used to describe those who possess an immense amount of knowledge and wisdom.
